name: Tapejara
sum: Small tapejarid with a semicircular snout crest, from the Santana Group of Brazil.
holotype: MN 6595-V — Romualdo Formation, Araripe Basin (survived the 2018 Museu Nacional fire, condition unknown).
material: Partial skulls (AMNH 24440 with mandible and a neck vertebra).
biology: Toothless downturned beak; bite-force studies suggest a herbivorous diet of fruit, seeds and tougher plant matter.
author: Kellner 1989

species.name: Tapejara wellnhoferi
species.author: Kellner 1989
species.ref: A. W. A. Kellner. 1989. A new edentate pterosaur of the Lower Cretaceous from the Araripe Basin, northeast Brazil. Anais da Academia Brasileira de Ciências 61(4):439-446
